name: DaxLib.SVG.Def.Line

parameters.name: defId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the line

parameters.name: x1
parameters.description: The x position of the start point

parameters.name: y1
parameters.description: The y position of the start point

parameters.name: x2
parameters.description: The x position of the end point

parameters.name: y2
parameters.description: The y position of the end point

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Optional: Direct SVG attributes to apply (e.g., "stroke-width='2' stroke='blue'"), can generate with `DaxLib.SVG.Attr.*` or manually

parameters.name: transforms
parameters.description: Optional: Transformation to apply (can be generated with `DaxLib.SVG.Transforms`)

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Def.Line' =
		(
			defId: STRING,
			x1: STRING,
			y1: STRING,
			x2: STRING,
			y2: STRING,
			attributes: STRING,
			transforms: STRING
		) =>

			"<line id='" & defId & "'" &
			" x1='" & x1 & "'" &
			" y1='" & y1 & "'" &
			" x2='" & x2 & "'" &
			" y2='" & y2 & "'" &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( attributes ), " " & attributes & " " ) &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( transforms ), " transform='" & transforms & "'" ) &
			"/>"
